summary.title: Fixing main.py to print Hello, world!
summary.body: I inspected the project and found two bugs: `main.py` imported from the nonexistent `greetings` module instead of `greeter`, and `greeter.py` was missing a colon after `def greet(name)`. I fixed both with `sed`, and `python3 main.py` now runs cleanly and prints `Hello
